const data = [
  {a: "A", b: 28},
  {a: "B", b: 55},
  {a: "C", b: 43}
];

const width = 300;
const step = 20;
const paddingInner = 0.1;
const paddingOuter = 0.05;
const n = data.length;
const height = step * (n - paddingInner + 2 * paddingOuter);
const margin = {top: 10, right: 30, bottom: 40, left: 30};

const svg = d3.select("body").append("svg")
  .attr("width", width + margin.left + margin.right)
  .attr("height", height + margin.top + margin.bottom)
  .style("background", "white");

const g = svg.append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);

const x = d3.scaleLinear()
  .domain([0, 60])
  .range([0, width]);

const y = d3.scaleBand()
  .domain(data.map(d => d.a).sort())
  .range([0, height])
  .paddingInner(paddingInner)
  .paddingOuter(paddingOuter);

g.append("g")
  .call(d3.axisBottom(x)
    .ticks(Math.ceil(width / 40))
    .tickSize(-height)
    .tickFormat(() => ""))
  .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height})`)
  .call(g => g.select(".domain").remove())
  .call(g => g.selectAll(".tick line")
    .attr("stroke", "#ddd")
    .attr("transform", `translate(0,${-height})`));

g.selectAll(".bar")
  .data(data)
  .join("rect")
  .attr("x", 0)
  .attr("y", d => y(d.a))
  .attr("width", d => x(d.b))
  .attr("height", y.bandwidth())
  .attr("fill", "#4c78a8");

// Add arrow and annotation for maximum value
const maxVal = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.b));
const maxBar = data.find(d => d.b === maxVal);

g.append("g")
  .selectAll(".annotation")
  .data([maxBar])
  .join("g")
  .append("path")
  .attr("d", function(d) {
    const barX = x(d.b);
    return `M ${barX + 5} ${y(d.a) + y.bandwidth()/2} L ${barX + 15} ${y(d.a) + y.bandwidth()/2} 
           L ${barX + 10} ${y(d.a) + y.bandwidth()/2 + 5}`;
  })
  .attr("fill", "none")
  .attr("stroke", "black")
  .attr("stroke-width", 2);

g.append("g")
  .selectAll(".annotation-text")
  .data([maxBar])
  .join("text")
  .attr("x", d => x(d.b) + 20)
  .attr("y", d => y(d.a) + y.bandwidth()/2)
  .attr("dominant-baseline", "central")
  .attr("text-anchor", "start")
  .attr("fill", "black")
  .style("font-size", "11px")
  .text("Maximum");

// Add reference line for average value
const average = data.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.b, 0) / data.length;
g.append("line")
  .attr("x1", margin.left)
  .attr("x2", width + margin.left)
  .attr("y1", y1 => x(average))
  .attr("y2", y1 => x(average))
  .attr("stroke", "dashed")
  .attr("stroke-width", 1)
  .attr("stroke-color", "black");

g.append("g")
  .call(d3.axisBottom(x)
    .ticks([42])
    .tickFormat(d => d === 42 ? "Average" : ""))
  .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height})`)
  .call(g => g.selectAll("text").style("font-size", "11px"));

g.selectAll(".bar")
  .data(data)
  .join("rect")
  .attr("x", 0)
  .attr("y", d => y(d.a))
  .attr("width", d => x(d.b))
  .attr("height", y.bandwidth())
  .attr("fill", d => d.b === maxVal ? "#ff4444" : "#4c78a8");

g.selectAll(".label")
  .data(data)
  .join("text")
  .attr("x", d => x(d.b) + 3)
  .attr("y", d => y(d.a) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
  .attr("dominant-baseline", "central")
  .attr("text-anchor", "start")
  .attr("fill", "black")
  .style("font-size", "11px")
  .text(d => d.b);

g.append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height})`)
  .call(d3.axisBottom(x).ticks(Math.ceil(width / 40)))
  .call(g => g.selectAll("text").style("font-size", "11px"))
  .append("text")
  .attr("x", width / 2)
  .attr("y", 30)
  .attr("fill", "black")
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("font-size", "11px")
  .text("b");

g.append("g")
  .call(d3.axisLeft(y))
  .call(g => g.selectAll("text").style("font-size", "11px"))
  .append("text")
  .attr("transform", "rotate(-90)")
  .attr("x", -height / 2)
  .attr("y", -20)
  .attr("fill", "black")
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("font-size", "11px")
  .text("a");
